vulnerability.impact: Groovy scripting sandbox escape leading to remote code execution

entry_points: GroovyScriptEngineService.compile/execute - dynamic Groovy scripting is enabled by default with script.groovy.sandbox.enabled=true
GroovySandboxExpressionChecker.isAuthorized - vulnerable 1.4.2 checker lets method-pointer expressions (obj.&method) and methods such as class/forName/invokeMethod reach the blacklist bypass
ground_truth.fix_commit: Fixed in Elasticsearch 1.4.3 (and 1.3.8) by disabling sandboxing for Groovy by default plus hardening the checker. No single canonical upstream commit; the relevant 1.4.x change set is ee231133ca0e318ee18a6b1badd8368337f5e59a (Disallow method pointer expressions in Groovy scripting), 68c4a6201e6c889b272c1b64550237fe6d172b47 (dynamically additive sandbox method blacklist) and 0aa1e540103dbb91357c9806aba907fbc2ad937a (append-only blacklist patch). NOTE: 4e952b2d75de6ca4caf4b6743462714f3b60d07f, sometimes cited for 1.4.3, is a test-only change ([TEST] make sandbox settings explicit in Tests) and is not the security fix. Pinned snapshot elasticsearch-1.4.2 is vulnerable.
ground_truth.finding_match_rule: TP: report identifies that a Groovy dynamic script can call methods such as class.forName / method-pointer expressions to escape the Groovy sandbox (GroovyScriptEngineService/GroovySandboxExpressionChecker), names CVE-2015-1427, and attributes remote code execution. Findings that only discuss enabling/disabling dynamic scripting without the sandbox bypass sink are not TP.
ground_truth.safe_reproduction_predicate: Static predicate: 1.4.2 defaults script.groovy.sandbox.enabled=true and its checker authorizes method-pointer expressions; 1.4.3 flips the default to false and blocks MethodPointerExpression (verified by diff of v1.4.2 vs v1.4.3 sources). Dynamic reproduction: run a local single-node ES 1.4.2 in a disposable container and issue a read-only search/script request with a benign expression (no filesystem/network action) to observe sandbox behavior.
